analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited reported a total income of Rs. 12,913.84 lakhs for the financial year 2024-25, with continuing operations showing notable improvement. The company successfully completed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, which commenced trading in March 2025. The Board recommended a dividend of 10% (Rs. 1 per share), resulting in a total outflow of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company is committed to driving profitable revenue growth by developing and commercializing high-margin, research-driven products.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company aims to consistently invest in R&D, adopt emerging technologies, and enhance its product portfolio.
guidance.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

guidance.claim: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research-based high-margin products.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: The company plans to venture into new markets with favorable competition and work on new, complex products as it enters fiscal 2024.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

guidance.claim: The company intends to leverage its R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and customer-centric products to reach new heights.
guidance.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's growth has been significantly supported by its extensive presence across India and its expanding global footprint.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is continuously enhancing its product portfolio to address changing market demands.
demand_outlook.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprints have yielded rich dividends.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company did not incur any capital expenditure on research and development during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: the expenditure incurred on Research and Development Capital Expenditure - Nil

capex_expansion.claim: The company has not made any specific capital investments in energy conservation equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: No specific investment has been made in energy conservation equipment's

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved a scheme of arrangement to demerge its Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's foreign exchange outgo for machinery was Rs. 187,919.00.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focused on developing and commercializing high-margin, research-driven products.
margins_costs.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

margins_costs.claim: The average remuneration of employees, excluding whole-time directors and managerial personnel, increased by 9.70% during the financial year 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: The average remuneration of employees excluding the whole time Directors and managerial persons increased by 9.70% during the financial year 2024-25 as compared to the aggregate increase of (13.57%) in the remuneration of the whole-time directors and other key managerial persons.

margins_costs.claim: The impact of energy conservation measures on costs cannot be accurately quantified.
margins_costs.quote: As the impact of measures taken for conservation and optimum utilization of energy are not quantitative, its impact on cost cannot be stated accurately.

margins_costs.claim: The company's revenue expenditure on Research and Development was Rs. 16,07,578.44.
The company's foreign exchange outgo for raw materials was Rs. 621,000.00.
The company's finance cost for the financial year 2022-23 was Rs. 116.94 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 10%, amounting to Rs 1 per equity share of Rs 10 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend payout will result in an outflow of Rs 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount from its profits to reserves for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not make any loans, guarantees, or investments under Section 186 during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review there are no loans, guarantees or investments under section 186 made by the company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not make any contribution to its Group Gratuity Fund during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year no contribution was made towards this fund.

capital_allocation.claim: The demerger of the aromatic chemicals business is expected to allow each company to raise capital independently based on their requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will result in a total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/-.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 5% on equity shares of Rs. 10 each, amounting to Rs. 0.50 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.50 per share on post bonus enhanced paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared and allotted 25,086,280 bonus shares in the ratio of 4 equity shares for every 1 equity share held.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the company has declared issue of bonus shares to the shareholders in the ratio of 4 Equity shares for every 1 equity shares held. The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

capital_allocation.claim: The paid-up equity share capital of the company as of March 31, 2023, was Rs. 313,578,500.
capital_allocation.quote: The paid up Equity Share Capital as on 31st March, 2023 was Rs. 313578500.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's profit after tax decreased primarily due to the demerger of a business unit.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has implemented a Risk Management Policy to identify risks that could threaten its existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continuously identifies risks related to business strategy, operations, compliance, financial reporting, IT, and cyber security.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The Board has undertaken to take care of secretarial audit qualifications and comply with them in the future.
management_commitments.quote: The Board has also undertaken to take care of such qualification and to comply with the same in future.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue its transformation journey in fiscal 2024 by entering new markets and working on complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.
